title: Understanding Gen Z and Their Unique Risk Factors
excerpt: Generation Z faces distinct challenges and risk factors shaped by their digital upbringing and societal changes. This article explores these risks and offers insights into how to address them effectively.
metaDescription: Explore the unique risk factors affecting Generation Z, including mental health challenges, social media impact, and economic pressures.

title: Congress Launches ‘MGNREGA Bachao Abhiyan’ From January 5; Kharge Warns Modi Govt. of People’s Backlash
excerpt: The Congress party has announced the launch of the ‘MGNREGA Bachao Abhiyan’ starting January 5, aimed at safeguarding the rural employment scheme. Opposition leader Mallikarjun Kharge has cautioned the Modi government about mounting public anger due to alleged neglect of MGNREGA benefits.
metaDescription: Congress launches ‘MGNREGA Bachao Abhiyan’ from Jan 5 to protect rural jobs. Kharge warns Modi govt. about growing people’s anger over MGNREGA issues.
author: HOCS team

title: Thailand and Cambodia Agree on Ceasefire to End Weeks of Deadly Fighting
excerpt: After weeks of intense conflict along their border, Thailand and Cambodia have reached an agreement to implement a ceasefire. This move brings hope for peace and stability in the region.
metaDescription: Thailand and Cambodia agree on ceasefire to end weeks of deadly border clashes, aiming to restore peace and stability.
author: HOCS team
